en.popupDesc: Experience the beauty and abundance of the "Rama IX International Mangrove Botanical Garden," the world's first mangrove botanical garden at Ban Samet Ngam, through 2 smart map navigation formats.
en.c1Title: Wellness Route
en.c1Desc: Walk or cycle around the mangrove forest for exercise.
en.c2Title: Spiritual Route
en.c2Desc: Pay homage and seek blessings from the sacred entities revered by the villagers.
en.c3Desc: Capture the golden evening light that reflects the traditional way of life in the mangrove forest.
en.wellnessDesc: Experience the atmosphere of the mangrove forest and breathe in fresh air at Chanthaburi's largest new green lung.
en.spiritualDesc: Follow the beliefs and spirituality of Ban Samet Ngam and feel the power of nature along the King Rama IX trail for good fortune.
en.sightseeingDesc: A viewpoint for photography enthusiasts and those who love admiring the beautiful scenery of the mangrove forest.
